$comment: Workspace packages the application declares as dependencies and never imports, each naming the feature that will consume it. `scripts/verify-dead-exports.mjs` fails on an unused package that is NOT listed here, AND on a listing that IS imported or whose feature is already done. Same shape and same reason as unreached-tokens.json and unreachable-routes.json (ADR-0088). THE WHOLE LIST PRINTS ON EVERY RUN.
$readingComment: A package listed here builds, tests and passes every gate — and the product never calls it. That is the failure mode this file exists to make visible, and it is invisible by construction otherwise: the tests check the package, and nothing checks that anything uses it. THE LIST IS EMPTY, AND THAT IS A RESULT RATHER THAN A DEFAULT (F-209): its one entry named a closing feature twice and was wrong twice, and the package it named was retired rather than re-pointed at a third. NFR-26 says the exception expires with the feature it names — an empty list is what that rule looks like when it is followed.
